title: You may lose your money if you didn't check your mailbox or this comment before downloading the app
body:
THEY ARE BAD AT PROGRAMMING AND TAKING RESPONSIBILITY ABOUT THAT

They "technically" allow you to subscribe and pay for the trial in the (website). But they couldn't link the email you used -to subscribe- to an actual account in their (app).

So if you download the app via app store, or sign in using the same email but not their only way to log in, you lost your only chance to get into your account with the paid subscription. Without refunding your money.

Also, they "technically" allow you to pay for their textbook in the (website). but if you ask to get your money back because you couldn't get into your paid subscription and you couldn't open the textbook they sent to your email, they will tell about their policy about (in-app) purchases. So no money back also.

(in-app) Yah the one you couldn't use it in the first place!
